# TPC-Havoc Q4_v9

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o_orderpriority) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) AND o_orderdate < CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate) ORDER BY o_orderpriority
```
